_doc: convert.json — myrepo Blog MD→HTML Conversion Spec v3
_description: This file is the single source of truth for how Markdown written in a GitHub Issue is converted to a styled HTML blog post. generate-blog.js reads the Frontmatter and Content sections. blog-styles.css provides all visual styling. Update this file whenever the spec changes — the script and styles should stay in sync with it.
_workflow: GitHub Issue body → generate-blog.js parses this spec → writes /blogs/<slug>/<slug>.html

outputStructure._comment: Every blog post outputs THREE artefacts inside public/
outputStructure.stylesheet: public/blogs/blog-styles.css     — shared CSS for all pages (NOT per-post)

frontmatter._comment: YAML block delimited by --- at the top of the issue body

summary.example: A deep-dive into baud rate mismatches

image.rules: Hero image URL. Prefer real online sources (Unsplash, official screenshots). AI-generated only as last resort.

image_credit.rules: Human-readable credit label. Required when image is set and sourced externally.

image_credit_url.rules: Link target for the credit label. Required when image_credit is set.

preferenceOrder: 1. Real URL from a credible online source (Unsplash, official product screenshot, news outlet, etc.)
2. Screenshot taken during the work being described
3. AI-generated — only if no real source is found; must include prompt in img-credit
imageRules.creditRequirement: All externally sourced images MUST have image_credit + image_credit_url set in frontmatter. AI-generated images must use the img-credit paragraph pattern in the post body.
imageRules.citationStyle: Inline citations in post body use [1] [2] superscript notation, resolved in a References section at the end of the long-read.

frontmatter.exampleBlock:
---
title: "My STM32 UART Journey"
slug: "my-stm32-uart-journey"
date: "2026-05-23"
summary: "Debugging baud rate mismatches on the STM32F103."
tags: [embedded, stm32, uart]
image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=1200&q=80"
image_credit: "Gabriel Heinzer on Unsplash"
image_credit_url: "https://unsplash.com/photos/VieM9BdZKFo"
---

postStructure._comment: Every post MUST follow this two-layer structure: short read first, long read collapsed below.

shortRead.description: The first 2–3 paragraphs. Summary of what happened and why it matters. Target read time: 30–60 seconds.
rules: Lead with what was built or discovered — no preamble
No subheadings inside the short read section
Must stand alone — reader should understand the core story without expanding

longRead.description: The full technical detail. Greyed out and collapsed by default. Reader clicks to expand. Target additional read time: 2–3 minutes.
rules: Starts after the visual expand trigger (three animated dots pill)
Code blocks, tables, images with captions allowed
Inline citations [1] [2] go here — resolved in a References section at the very end
References section is the last element inside long-read
longRead.triggerHtml: Three-dot animated pill button between short-read and long-read sections (see pageShell.expandTrigger)

markdownConvention.shortReadMarker: Write the first 2–3 paragraphs as plain prose (no special marker needed — generator treats everything before the first ## as short-read)
markdownConvention.longReadMarker: Place a literal line containing only `<!-- more -->` after the short-read paragraphs to tell the generator where the long-read begins
markdownConvention.referencesSection: Use `## References` as the final heading inside long-read. Generator converts it to an <ol> list of credited URLs.

tone.style: Technical but approachable — assumes the reader knows what code is, but does not assume domain expertise
prefer: Show what happened then explain why

markdownToHtml._comment: Rules the generate-blog.js script follows when converting Markdown prose to HTML. Every output element uses a CSS class from blog-styles.css.
processingOrder: 1. Strip frontmatter block (everything before and including the second ---)
2. Split on <!-- more --> — everything before = short-read, everything after = long-read
3. Fenced code blocks  (``` ... ```)  →  FIRST, before inline rules touch the content
7. Images with caption  (![alt](src) + *caption* on next line)  →  <figure>

h1.notes: Only one H1 per post; use sparingly inside body

fenced.notes: lang attribute preserved for future syntax highlighter

links.notes: All links open in new tab

aiGenerated._note: When the image is AI-generated, add a .img-credit paragraph immediately after the or inside
aiGenerated.html: AI-generated · Prompt: "your prompt here"
aiGenerated.cssStyle: font-size: 0.6rem; color: var(--color-text-faint); text-align: center; font-style: italic;

table.notes: Separator row (|---|---| pattern) is stripped; first row becomes <thead>

inline.notes: Superscript inline citation, links to #ref-N anchor in References section

references.notes: Must be last element inside long-read. Each list item gets id="ref-N" for anchor targeting.

pageShell._comment: The HTML wrapper that generate-blog.js injects converted content into
pageShell.fonts: Google Fonts via <link> in <head> — Instrument Serif (display) + Work Sans (body)
pageShell.stylesheet: <link rel="stylesheet" href="../blog-styles.css"> — one level up from /blogs/<slug>/

sections.siteHeader: <header class="site-header"> — sticky, blur backdrop, logo + theme toggle + 'All posts' link
sections.heroImage:
If frontmatter.image is set: followed by

{image_credit}

. Omit both elements if image is not set.
sections.main: <main id="main-content"> → <article> → <header class="post-header reveal"> + <hr class="post-divider"> + short-read section + expand trigger + long-read section
sections.siteFooter: <footer class="site-footer"> — '← Back to all posts' link

shortLongReadHtml._comment: Structure generate-blog.js emits for the two-layer reading experience
shortLongReadHtml.longRead: <section class="long-read" id="long-read" role="region">{long-read content including references}</section>

scripts.themeToggle: Inline <script> — reads system preference, sets data-theme on <html>, toggles on button click
scripts.scrollReveal: Inline <script> — IntersectionObserver on .reveal elements, adds .visible class at 0.1 threshold
scripts.expandTrigger: Inline <script> — clicking #trigger adds .open to #long-read, dismisses trigger with fade-out animation

cssClassMap._comment: Quick reference: Markdown element → HTML element → CSS class in blog-styles.css
cssClassMap.postMeta: .post-meta     — date + tags row above the title
cssClassMap.postTitle: .post-title    — <h1> in article header, Instrument Serif display font
cssClassMap.longRead: .long-read     — collapsed by default, .open class shows it
cssClassMap.readTrigger: .read-trigger  — three-dot pill expand button between sections
cssClassMap.postBody: .post-body     — wrapper div around all converted Markdown HTML
cssClassMap.tag: .tag           — individual tag badge rendered from frontmatter tags[]
cssClassMap.heroImg: .hero-img      — full-width hero image at top of post
cssClassMap.heroCredit: .hero-credit   — small credit line below hero image
cssClassMap.references: .references    — References section at end of long-read

listingPage._comment: public/blogs/index.html is auto-generated/updated by generate-blog.js on each new post
listingPage.stylesheet: <link rel="stylesheet" href="./blog-styles.css"> — same level as listing

entryHtml._comment: Card renders hero image when frontmatter.image is set, falls back to no-image card if not
entryHtml.withImage: • {date}{title}{summary}

listingPage.insertionPoint: New entries are prepended before so newest posts appear first

designSystem._comment: Summary of the visual design — see blog-styles.css for full token values

fonts.display: Instrument Serif (Google Fonts) — used for post titles, headings inside post body, site logo
fonts.body: Work Sans (Google Fonts) — all body copy, UI chrome, tags, metadata

designSystem.palette: Nexus — warm beige surfaces (#f7f6f2 light, #171614 dark) + Hydra Teal accent (#01696f light, #4f98a3 dark)
designSystem.modes: light (default) + dark — via [data-theme] attribute toggled by inline JS + prefers-color-scheme fallback
designSystem.animations: Scroll-reveal: .reveal elements fade in (opacity 0→1) + slide up (translateY 20px→0) via IntersectionObserver
designSystem.typography: Fluid clamp() scale — text-xs (12px) through text-2xl (56px). Body at text-base (16-18px). Post title at text-2xl. H2 at text-xl.

skillIntegration._comment: How Perplexity (via .perplexity/skills/create-blog.md) must format the issue body to match this spec
skillIntegration.issueBody: Frontmatter YAML block (--- ... ---) followed by Markdown content. Short-read paragraphs first, then <!-- more -->, then long-read content, then ## References.
skillIntegration.verifyStep: Draft is first saved to Notion /Blogs folder as DRAFT. User reviews and approves before Perplexity creates the GitHub Issue.
skillIntegration.imageRule: Hero/inline images: prefer real URLs (Unsplash, screenshots) with image_credit + image_credit_url in frontmatter. AI-generated images get .img-credit paragraph in post body. Never hallucinate URLs.
